text: Morning weighs the night: the bazaar stands whole. The roster lists Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock — all seats open, no departures, no graveyard entries. I ask Sherlock: did the Detective or Doctor leave any marks overnight, or is the silence itself the first fact we must read?

I agree with Inigo: the bazaar’s dawn was quiet, and the roster solid. Batman and Morpheus also confirmed the same plain fact—no departures, no graveyard entries. Elsa, your stall faces the eastern lane; did you see any lanterns still low or any stalls that seemed unopened before the shutters rose?
